sources.snippet: ImageWAM: R1Lite insert flower Final 20-epoch / step 11,440 inference checkpoint for the R1Lite right arm. This is a full fine-tune, not a LoRA adapter. It contains visual/action MoT weights and the trained proprio encoder, not optimizer or resumable state. No robot rollout success rate is claimed by this release.
